_about: Master filter taxonomy for the CRO Element Library. You own this file — edit values freely. The pipeline only uses values listed here; anything it wants to add goes into _proposed for your review, never straight into the live lists.

page_types: Content Page (Shopify page / custom page template)

_notes: multi_value lists which dimensions an element can hold more than one of. 'ease' = implementation effort (Easy = theme-editor/no-code, Complex = metafields + heavy Liquid). 'impact' = CRO expert's expected conversion/AOV lift, not the ticket's own priority.
